summary_en: Introduces learned data-domain compensation for transducer spatial impulse response in 3D photoacoustic computed tomography. A purely data-driven model and a physics-inspired Deconv-Net map SIR-corrupted measurements to point-detector-equivalent data, enabling subsequent fast reconstruction while recovering structures blurred by finite-aperture transducers. Virtual studies and in-vivo breast data show improved resolution and robustness, with at least 30% lower relative squared error than the reported baseline.
